question: In which year did the New India Literacy Programme begin?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2022-23**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The New India Literacy Programme (NILP) was launched by the Government of India in the financial year **2022-23**.
 
• It aims to address the issue of adult illiteracy across the country and is focused on achieving the goal of functional literacy for non-literates aged 15 years and above.
 
• The programme is aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, which emphasizes the importance of lifelong learning and equitable access to education.
 
• The NILP replaces the earlier scheme known as the **Saakshar Bharat Programme**, which concluded in 2017.
 
• The implementation of the NILP involves coordination between central and state governments, leveraging **technology-driven methods** and volunteerism to enhance reach and efficacy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Functional Literacy:**

 
 
• Functional literacy refers to the ability to read, write, and perform basic arithmetic tasks essential for everyday life.
 
• The NILP seeks to ensure that adult learners can effectively engage in social, economic, and cultural activities.
 
 
 
• **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020:**
 
 
• The NEP 2020 provides a framework for transforming India's education system, focusing on inclusivity and lifelong learning.
 
• Adult education and literacy initiatives under the NEP emphasize skill development and digital literacy.
 
 
 
• **Saakshar Bharat Programme:**
 
 
• Launched in 2009, Saakshar Bharat focused on promoting literacy in rural areas, particularly among women.
 
• It was concluded in 2017, paving the way for the New India Literacy Programme.
 
 
 
• **Volunteer-Based Implementation:**
 
 
• The NILP encourages community participation through volunteer-based teaching and learning models.
 
• Volunteers receive training and resources to aid in the delivery of literacy programmes.
 
 
 
• **Technology Integration:**
 
 
• The NILP leverages digital platforms and e-learning tools to enhance accessibility and engagement for learners.
 
• Mobile apps and online modules are being used to facilitate education for adult learners.
